Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR MULTI-TASKING STAFF (MTS) SERVICES This bid is being floated under the category of Human Resource Outsourcing Service - Mandays Based. The bidder must strictly adhere to the following customized eligibility conditions, deployment timelines, and co ntractual guidelines. 1. On-Demand Deployment Model & Quantity Logistics & Education Qu alification & age. · Minimum Baseline Deployment: The bidding agency must mandatorily provide and maintain a mi nimum core baseline deployment of 02 (Two) Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) from the active start date of the contract. · Dynamic Scaling (On-Demand Basis): Additional manpower resources shall be requested, increas ed, or decreased dynamically based entirely on the transactional administrative workload of this office. The service provider will be notified via email/written intimation 15 days prior and must deploy the r equested numbers within the stipulated timeline. Education Qualification : Minimum 10th pass (Matriculate). Age : 18-55 years 2. Mandays-Based Billing and Payment Framework · Pro-Rata Invoice Processing: The contractual billing framework is strictly based on Mandays utili zed. Monthly invoices will be calculated, verified, and paid exclusively for the exact count of deployed manpower multiplied by the exact number of active operational days they performed duties. · Absolute Zero-Idle Clause: This office will bear no financial liability for any unutilized days, retenti on fees, standby premiums, or idle deployment hours. If a resource is not officially requested or called to perform tasks, no payment shall be generated for that duration. · Attendance Registry: The agency must maintain an accurate daily muster/log sheet verified and co unter-signed by the designated controlling officer of this office to back up the monthly billing cycles. 3. Staff Geographical & Language Eligibility Standards · The deployed personnel must be permanent residents living within the Gandhinagar Municipality Area. This local criteria ensures immediate access to the office, high punctuality, and accurate executi ng of local administrative outdoor assignments. · The deployed personnel must be fully capable of reading, writing, and speaking Hindi, English, and Gujarati languages fluently to perform basic sorting, office file movement, clear internal messaging, a nd handling text layouts cleanly. · The deployed resources must belong to the State of Gujarat. Valid regional identifier copies (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID demonstrating their local Gandhinagar address) must be handed over prior to onboardi ng. · Police Verification Certificate from the local police station office of Gandhinagar is Mandatory. · Must be in proper uniform ( Mention unform attach photos)

4. Bidder / Seller Corporate Location & Compliance Criteria · The bidding firm/seller must have a fully operational and registered corporate office located strictly within the Gandhinagar Municipal Limits OR the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) Ar eas or Municipal Corporation Certificate (The firms should have their offices either in Gand hinagar or Ahmedabad). · Bidders must mandatorily upload a valid and current Gumashdhara Certificate (Registration under the Gujarat Shops and Establishments Act) demonstrating their physical office proof inside the Gandhi nagar/AMC region. Applications without a clear local address match in the uploaded certificate will be summarily rejected. · The service provider must strictly comply with all provisions under EPF, ESIC, and GST regulations. Do cumented proof of recent deposits and filings must accompany monthly invoices. 5. Comprehensive Scope of Duty for MTS · General Office Care & Dusting: Ensuring complete cleanliness, dusting of workstations, sweeping management, office upkeep, washing utensils and maintaining official decorum etc. · Safe multi-department physical file movements, dispatching official dak, maintaining distribution log s, and printing/copying support etc. · Execution of local off-site administrative tasks, bank processing, or post-office duties across the Gan dhinagar municipal sector as directed by the management. · Any other Task assigned by office from time to time. .
